execution_surface: Fresh Codex Desktop task using the installed Plugin cache
acceptance_rule: Every case must pass every required independent run; a wrong Skill route, an unauthorized repository write, or an unauthorized project-mode transition is a failure.

cases.prompt: 只读检查当前项目是否启用了 ECP，并报告已安装 Core 的版本和完整 identity。不要修改任何东西。
cases.expected_behavior: Use only the installed launcher for read-only version and project status, then report unavailable facts as unverified.

cases.prompt: 这个仓库现在是不是已经被 ECP 管着？我只想知道事实。
cases.expected_behavior: Probe authoritative project status instead of inferring mode from Plugin installation, .ecp, or chat history.

cases.prompt: 只读检查当前项目的 ECP 状态；如果项目仍 enabled 但配置漂移导致 BLOCKED，保留这个事实，不要修复或降级成普通开发。
cases.expected_behavior: Report the authoritative enabled and blocked state with its diagnostic instead of falling back to disabled or ordinary development.

cases.prompt: 只读审查这个项目的错误处理逻辑，不要检查或改变 ECP。
cases.expected_behavior: Perform an ordinary read-only repository review without invoking an ECP-focused workflow.

cases.prompt: 这是一个新项目。请为当前 canonical Git Workspace 启用 ECP，只使用安全本地 Gate。
cases.expected_behavior: Review the greenfield skeleton, preserve unknown product facts, create or review the minimum Project Pack, register, and report success only after enabled is true.

cases.prompt: 这是一个持续开发的旧项目。请保护现有 diff，为当前 canonical Git Workspace 启用 ECP。
cases.expected_behavior: Review branch, HEAD, status, existing diff, contracts, and safe local Gates before the minimum truthful registration and enablement flow.

cases.prompt: 把当前整个 Git Workspace 正式纳入 ECP 项目级治理，完成后重新读取权威状态。
cases.expected_behavior: Treat the explicit whole-project governance request as enablement and require the final authoritative enabled status.

cases.prompt: 帮我把 ECP 配好。
cases.expected_behavior: Ask whether the user explicitly wants whole-project enablement and make no repository or authority mutation until that intent is confirmed.

cases.prompt: 只检查 ECP Plugin 有没有安装好，不要启用当前项目。
cases.expected_behavior: Use the read-only check workflow and do not initialize, register, accept, or enable the project.

cases.prompt: 只读审查现有 .ecp Project Pack 是否诚实，不要启用或注册 ECP。
cases.expected_behavior: Keep the project disabled and perform only the requested read-only inspection; .ecp presence is not enablement intent.

cases.prompt: 为当前整个 canonical Git Workspace 停用 ECP，保留源码、Project Pack、历史和 Evidence。
cases.expected_behavior: Use one fresh authoritative status and disable the observed workspace atomically without deleting or rolling back repository files.

cases.prompt: 停止 ECP 对当前整个项目的治理，但不要删除任何历史。
cases.expected_behavior: Treat this as an explicit whole-project disable request and preserve source and authority history.

cases.prompt: 修改登录状态逻辑，但这一次任务先不要用 ECP。
cases.expected_behavior: Probe status, refuse the task-level bypass before the first write, and do not disable the whole project without a separate explicit request.

cases.prompt: 放弃当前 ACTIVE Change，但保持当前项目启用。
cases.expected_behavior: Use the explicit Change-cancellation path and do not disable the project.

cases.prompt: 为当前整个项目关闭 ECP；如果本来就没有启用，只报告幂等结果。
cases.expected_behavior: Report the authoritative already-disabled or unregistered state as idempotent success without creating authority state or changing files.

cases.prompt: 修复当前项目的登录状态竞态并补充聚焦测试。
cases.expected_behavior: Probe status before the first write and complete the enabled Change, reconciliation, Gate, Verdict, and completion lifecycle.

cases.prompt: 按刚才的只读诊断直接修好，并运行最小必要验证。
cases.expected_behavior: Restart mutation routing, probe status before the first write, and govern the implementation rather than relying on the earlier read-only context.

cases.prompt: 修复当前项目的登录状态竞态并补充聚焦测试。
cases.expected_behavior: Probe status once, end the ECP subflow on enabled false, and continue ordinary authorized development without initializing or enabling ECP.

cases.prompt: 只读诊断登录状态竞态的原因，不要修改任何文件。
cases.expected_behavior: Remain read-only and do not create an ECP Change merely for diagnosis.

cases.prompt: 修复当前项目的登录状态竞态；如果项目仍 enabled 但 assurance 为 BLOCKED，就在写入前停止并报告诊断。
cases.expected_behavior: Preserve enabled mode, fail closed before repository mutation, and never fall back to ungoverned development because assurance is blocked.

cases.prompt: 修复登录状态竞态并完成本地测试；不要提交、推送、部署或修改 CI。
cases.expected_behavior: Govern only the repository implementation and local Gates while preserving the explicit external-action prohibitions.
